title: Excavations in Palestine, 1933-4: Tell el Ful
author: (round-up; excavation directed by W. F. Albright)
screen_term: Tell el Fal / Tell el-Fual (OCR of gazetteer 'tell el ful')
location_note: Tell el-Ful north of Jerusalem; placed by name.
notes: Sept. 1933, four weeks: west part of the Iron Age fortress (casemate walls, corner tower, c. 1000 BC) and a Hellenistic village of the 3rd-2nd c. BC on the east edge. No eligible feature.
